title: Model Pipeline Steps and Dependencies
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Model Pipeline Steps and Dependencies.
learning_objectives: Explain model pipeline steps and dependencies using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for model pipeline steps and dependencies
Assess failure and operational limits of model pipeline steps and dependencies
concepts_covered: A pipeline is a set of jobs with dependency edges; a step has a command and execution settings.
Step contains dependencies, environment, retries, timeout, and secrets; Pipeline contains Steps.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
